properties.scope: Limón district is one independently documented local cultural reference for Limon Kryol. The original geoBoundaries-delivered OSM/Wambacher ADM3 feature represents 2017, not an October2026 survey, the restricted INEC UGED product, or a verified current legal DTA boundary. It is only a partial approximate local reference; it does not represent the whole province, Costa Rica, an exclusive/uniform/exhaustive speaker area or a printing proven exclusive to Limón centre. Speakers also live elsewhere, including the GAM. All581 original delivered XY positions retained, only ring winding may change. No automatic exact-location confirmation, acquisition location or personal visit is inferred. This language-level link is not a printing-specific association. Original OSM relation/version is not supplied by geoBoundaries and remains unknown.
